FAQ.title: Common Questions About SendTheSong
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know before you create, personalize, and send a song they’ll cherish forever.

items.question: How does SendTheSong work?
items.answer: It’s pure magic. Just tell us your story by answering a few simple questions, choose your favorite music genre, and we will craft a custom song instantly. You will get a free 60-second studio-quality preview. If you love it, unlock the full song and get access to our free video and print editors!

items.question: What makes you different from other custom song platforms?
items.answer: We don't just give you an audio file. We offer the most competitive pricing on the market, plus every song unlocks an unlimited library of free, customizable lyric video and printable wall art templates. You can use our built-in interactive editors to personalize them with your own photos and love notes.

items.question: Can I edit the lyrics or change the music genre?
items.answer: Absolutely! You are in complete control. Before unlocking the full high-res track, you can tweak the lyrics, change the musical style, or switch the vocal vibe inside our dashboard until it perfectly matches your vision.

items.question: How can I share my personalized music gift?
items.answer: Every song comes with a stunning, dedicated sharing page that you can send via text, email, or social media. You can fully customize this page with a personal image, a heartfelt note, and your personalized song playing on a spinning vinyl player. It's built to create a real wow-moment.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees, and is my payment secure?
items.answer: Zero hidden fees. You only pay when you are completely happy with your preview. All payments are encrypted and securely processed through Creem (PCI-compliant). We never store your credit card details on our servers.

items.question: How long are my custom songs stored?
items.answer: Your purchased tracks, custom lyric videos, and wall art layouts are stored on your account securely and indefinitely. You can log in to stream, replay, or re-download them in high-quality MP3 format at any time.

items.question: What are the login requirements?
items.answer: We keep it completely frictionless. You don't even need to register to start crafting your preview! We use a "lazy registration" system - simply enter your email to listen to your preview, and a guest account is silently created for you. You can sign in via Google or Email later anytime.

items.question: What if my song creation gets stuck?
items.answer: Our creation process is designed to be reliable, but network glitches can happen. If it gets stuck, refresh the page. If the issue persists, contact support and we will review the issue within 3 business days.
